theory.heading: What Prompt Management is
theory.body: Prompt Management describes the methods and patterns used within MERN Stack + Gen AI to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: Prompt Management is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why Prompt Management matters
theory.body: Without Prompt Management, systems built with MERN Stack + Gen AI are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Prompt Management works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Prompt Management follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of Prompt Management.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Prompt Management
theory.body: Prompt Management offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
